current_state: No identity provider integrated; Research OS runs offline with no real user authentication
target_state: Institutional SSO (SAML 2.0 or OIDC) integrated and enforced for all production users
required_control: Institutional SSO with session management; local accounts forbidden for research use
evidence_required: SSO integration test report; authentication log showing institutional actor IDs; IdP configuration review
verification_method: IQ-01 (shared account prevention); IQ-02 (role assignment); penetration test TP-SEC-01

current_state: No MFA in baseline; all access is password-free offline operation
target_state: MFA mandatory for 100% of production users with no bypass path on any authentication endpoint
required_control: MFA enforcement at identity provider level; API endpoints enforce MFA completion token; no SMS-only MFA
evidence_required: MFA enforcement test report; bypass attempt log showing rejection on all paths
verification_method: IQ-10 (MFA for privileged action); penetration test TP-SEC-01 (MFA bypass)

current_state: ReviewLedger contains username strings without identity verification; reviewer_id is user-supplied
target_state: Every write operation carries authenticated_actor_id verified by institutional identity provider
required_control: Session token from SSO verified on every write; actor ID recorded in audit event; no anonymous or pseudonymous write operations
evidence_required: Audit event samples showing authenticated_actor_id from IdP; token verification log

current_state: No RBAC persistence layer; role concepts exist in design only
target_state: RBAC roles persisted in service with PI-approved assignment; role expiry; role history audit trail
required_control: RBAC service with persistent role store; role assignment requires PI approval; automatic expiry enforcement
evidence_required: RBAC configuration documentation; role assignment test report; role expiry test
verification_method: IQ-02 (role assignment approval); IQ-03 (least privilege); IQ-08 (delegation expiry)

current_state: SoD exists as design in documentation only; no technical enforcement
target_state: SoD enforced technically: PI cannot self-review; admin cannot approve research content; author cannot be sole approver
required_control: RBAC service enforces SoD at action level; forbidden actions return permission denied at API layer
evidence_required: SoD test matrix results; role × action test report; IQ-03 and IQ-04 test evidence
verification_method: IQ-03 (least privilege); IQ-04 (PI self-review); IQ-06 (escalation prevention)
go_no_go_dependency: GATE-R1-G9 — BLOCKED if PI can self-review

current_state: No delegation register; Co-I activities not formally authorized in system
target_state: Authenticated delegation register: each delegation has PI signature; start/end date; permitted activities; revocation
required_control: Delegation register service; delegation required before delegated action; delegation_id in audit event; expiry enforcement
evidence_required: Delegation register test report; expiry test; revocation test; audit event with delegation_id

current_state: Audit log has username strings without authenticated identity; no role_at_event_time; no delegation_reference
target_state: Every audit event has authenticated_actor_id + actor_role_at_event_time + delegation_reference + object_hash + tamper-evident integrity
required_control: Write-once audit event store; hash chain or WORM storage; integrity verification procedure; admin cannot delete events
evidence_required: Audit event schema validation; immutability test (IQ-13); integrity check report; admin-delete rejection log
verification_method: IQ-09; IQ-13 (audit immutability); IQ-15 (break-glass logging); IQ-19 (backup integrity)
go_no_go_dependency: GATE-R1-G7 — BLOCKED if attribution not implemented

current_state: No formal access revocation procedure; no offboarding workflow in system
target_state: Joiner/Mover/Leaver process with defined SLA: all access revoked within 24h of departure; sessions terminated; delegation revoked
required_control: Offboarding procedure with technical enforcement; automated session termination on account deactivation; delegation auto-revocation
evidence_required: Offboarding test report (IQ-16); SLA measurement evidence; session termination log
go_no_go_dependency: GATE-R1-G3 — BLOCKED if 24h SLA not achievable

current_state: No periodic access review scheduled or performed
target_state: Quarterly access review by PI: verify all current role holders; remove stale access; document review outcome
required_control: Access review procedure; PI review checklist; quarterly schedule enforced; review outcome in audit log
evidence_required: First quarterly access review report; review outcome audit event; stale access removal log
verification_method: IQ-14 (administrator access review); periodic review schedule in Validation Plan

current_state: No privileged account management; admin accounts have broad access
target_state: Just-in-time privileged access elevation; admin actions audited separately; admin cannot access research data
required_control: PAM procedure; privileged session logging; admin access to research content blocked technically; separate admin audit trail
evidence_required: Privileged action audit trail; admin-access-to-research-data rejection log; PAM activation/deactivation log
verification_method: IQ-14 (administrator access review); IQ-15 (break-glass access logging)
go_no_go_dependency: GATE-R1-G4 — HOLD if admin has research data access

current_state: No break-glass procedure defined; identity provider outage would block all access without documented fallback
target_state: Break-glass procedure: second approval; automatic alert; full session logging; time-limited; post-use review
required_control: Break-glass account with MFA; approval workflow; alert to PI and SECURITY_ADMINISTRATOR; session recording; mandatory post-use review
evidence_required: Break-glass test report (IQ-15); IdP outage simulation result (IQ-18); alert evidence; post-use review template

current_state: No independent security test performed; no penetration test; no external validation of identity controls
target_state: Independent penetration test completed by tester external to development team; all critical findings CAPA closed
required_control: Independent security tester (not development team); test covers IDT-01 through IDT-12; signed test report; CAPA log
evidence_required: Signed penetration test report; CAPA log with 0 critical findings open; independent tester credentials documented
go_no_go_dependency: GATE-R5 — BLOCKED without independent security test
